title: LTFRB releases first batch of monthly subsidy to modern PUV operators

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) on Wednesday said it already released the first batch of monthly financial assistance to modern public utility vehicle (PUV) operators amounting to over P9 million. According to the LTFRB, 16 cheques worth P9,080,000 were issued to 16 Transport Service Entities (TSEs) across the country.
